validation_scope: all declared offline validation samples for each head and task; no Native or TEST selection
qualification: each observed candidate and TCP sample must be within 0.05m; report mean goal 0.03m separately; missing or nonfinite samples fail
checkpoint_selection: minimize worst task/head fraction above 0.05m, then worst task/head maximum, then worst task/head mean on offline validation only
scene_classifier: frozen v1 causal RGBD encoder, no task metadata input
time_label: max(first_expert_close_frame-anchor_frame,0)*0.05; nominal cache frame clock, not verified original HDF5 timestamp
